Hrvatski Nogometni klub Hajduk Split, commonly referred to as Hajduk Split, is a Croatian professional football club based in Split. They compete in the Croatian Football League (HNL), the top tier of Croatian football. Since 1979, the club's home ground has been the 33,987-seater Stadion Poljud. The team's traditional home colours are white shirts with blue shorts and blue socks.
